top_signals.title: How Russia Sees the World Now
top_signals.summary: Dmitry Adamsky, an expert on Russian security and Russian nuclear deterrence strategy at Harvard and Reichman Universities, examines a large-scale shift in Russia’s strategic thinking over the past year, centered around the view that Europe, rather than the United States, is now Russia’s primary geopolitical rival and adversary, and looking at the consequences of this shift for US efforts to end the war in Ukraine.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Tech Rally Deepens on Hynix Earnings, Oil Climbs: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: South Korean stocks led a third day of gains in global technology shares after blowout results from chip heavyweight SK Hynix Inc. prompted investors to charge back into the artificial intelligence trade. Crude oil rose.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Gold Slips to Near $4,000 as Focus Turns to Fed Rate Decision
top_signals.summary: Gold edged lower, testing the $4,000-an-ounce threshold ahead of the US Federal Reserve’s interest-rate decision due later Wednesday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Fortescue Says Iron Ore Deal With China Must Protect Australia
top_signals.summary: Fortescue Ltd.’s top executives said the miner won’t rush into a deal with China’s state-backed iron ore buyer, and that any agreement must protect the company’s long-term interests as well as Australia’s.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US, Australia Pledge to ‘Swiftly Execute’ Defense Collaboration
top_signals.summary: Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth and his Australian counterpart agreed Wednesday on the need to “swiftly execute” defense collaboration including a stronger force posture, amid growing Chinese military power in the region.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
